win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: WILD ROCKET
wilds.behavior:
When the special Wild Rocket symbol lands it reveals a multiplier: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x or 20x.The multiplier is then multiplied by the number of grid positions covered while expanding to the top of the grid.

 All expanded Wild Rocket positions count as Wild symbols and substitute for all paying symbols.

 When multiple Wild Rocket reels participate in the same win line their multipliers are added together.

 Wild Rocket symbols expand only if they are part of a winning combination.

scatters.name: BONUS SYMBOL
scatters.behavior: The Bonus scatter symbol can land only in the base game. Only one Bonus scatter symbol can land per reel.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - ROCKET RUSH
modes.trigger: landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.
modes.effects:
Trigger the Rocket Rush bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 During this bonus game there is an increased chance of landing Wild Rocket symbols!

modes.name: BONUS GAME - GALACTIC RAID
modes.trigger: landing 4 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.
modes.effects:
Trigger the Galactic Raid bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 During this bonus game there is an increased chance of landing Wild Rocket symbols! Wild Rocket symbols remain sticky for the duration of the bonus game and reveal a new initial multiplier on each spin.

 If a new Wild Rocket symbol lands below an existing one, it replaces it.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

ABOUT THE GAME

 Pull out your cutlass and fire up the Rocket! Pirate Rocket is a 5-reel, 5-row game with payline wins and a distinctive expand functionality. When the Wild Rocket symbol lands it reveals a multiplier and flies up to the top of the grid, multiplying its multiplier by the number of grid positions covered.

 The maximum win in this game is 12 500x your bet and can be achieved all game modes.
